justification: The run delivered a substantial, functional opening package: 101 doors and 120 windows across three occupied storeys, with every opening hosted, every one of 94 rooms having a door, compliant measured door widths, suitable lift doors, and no swing-rule findings. However, daylight coverage remains materially incomplete across all floors: four ground-floor studios have only borrowed internal glazing, and eight upper-floor studios have no windows, requiring significant rework before the whole-building opening task is acceptable.
evidence: Live measurements found 41/30/30 doors and 37/46/37 windows on storeys 1/2/3; the access check reported 94 rooms, 0 without doors, 32 reachable and 62 not linked to other floors. The window review found no exterior window for the ground-floor Movement Studio, Team Briefing, Warmup Studio and sports hall, while Dance, Martial Arts, Pilates and Yoga on floor 3 and Conditioning, Free Weights, Functional Training and Resistance Training on floor 2 had no window at all. The agent acknowledged part of this incompleteness: “Not met: eight studios on floors 2 and 3 have no window.”
strengths: Exact final count claim verified: 101 doors and 120 windows.
Whole-building coverage was attempted on all three occupied storeys rather than only the ground floor.
All 221 openings returned a valid wall host.
Every one of the 94 rooms has at least one door; ground-floor access reports all 32 rooms reachable.
Opening measurements showed no undersized doors or incorrect room-to-circulation swings under the applicable rules.
Single room doors measure 1.00 m nominal and 0.86 m clear; double doors measure about 1.94 m nominal.
All six lift landing doors are sliding and approximately 1.20 m nominal, opening between lift reservations and shared lift lobbies.
Window sill geometry is generally consistent: standard windows sit about 0.91 m above their storey floor, while the sports-hall clerestories are high level.
The agent openly disclosed the eight unwindowed upper-floor studios instead of claiming complete daylight coverage.
weaknesses: Four occupied ground-floor rooms—Movement Studio, Team Briefing, Warmup Studio and Equipment Induction—received fixed glazing into the sports hall rather than exterior daylight; borrowed internal glazing does not satisfy the daylight principle.
Eight occupied studios across floors 2 and 3 have no window: Conditioning, Free Weights, Functional Training, Resistance Training, Dance, Yoga, Pilates and Martial Arts.

The sports hall's four room-facing windows are internal borrowed-light openings; its exterior clerestories are recorded on storey 2 because they occupy the tall hall wall, making floor-by-floor verification less clear.

Upper-storey access remains unverified because all 62 upper rooms report not linked to other floors. This is contextual rather than penalized as missing stairs, but it prevents full end-to-end access verification.
Moving-leaf and sash collision clearance was not assessed beyond the opening measurements; double-door leaf locations are explicitly estimated.
Family-definition and instance fire-rating details could not be fully read, so the claimed 60-minute stair-door rating is not independently assessed.

spec_violations.constraint: Inspect and provide suitable doors and windows throughout every occupied storey.
spec_violations.what_happened: Door coverage is complete, but window coverage is incomplete on every occupied floor.
spec_violations.evidence: Four ground-floor occupied rooms have only internal borrowed glazing, while four studios on floor 2 and four studios on floor 3 have no windows.

spec_violations.constraint: Habitable rooms should receive daylight through a window in an outside wall.
spec_violations.what_happened: Twelve occupied rooms lack an exterior window; four use internal glazing into the sports hall and eight have no window.
spec_violations.evidence: Measured exterior-window room associations exclude the ground-floor Movement Studio, Team Briefing and Warmup Studio; access/window topology also lists eight named upper studios with no window.
